review_lines: The cited spans support MFU figures, 93% FlexAttention pass rate, SOTA profiler, and 'nowhere close to CUDA maturity.' But '30.47% MFU on Qwen3-32B' and '93% FlexAttention pass rate' — the 93% span (89/96 test cases) is not tied to FlexAttention in its cited span; FlexAttention pass rate is not explicitly supported by cited spans. The MFU figures come from Qwen3-32B training per cited span C-a0502962445309, so that part holds.

The cited spans support the tokens-per-dollar comparisons and the Oracle/OpenAI/Anthropic/Meta customers, but 'across four models' and 'winning external TPU inference customers' are not clearly tied to the customer span. The label MEASURED OBSERVATION is acceptable as the weakest among cited figures.

The cited C-0ebc2279393608 supports 'up to 50% better performance per dollar than B200 and B300.' But the 'FP8 on Qwen 3.5 397B single-turn' scoping is only loosely supported by C-049146e4b952f9 (Qwen3.5 397B FP8). The label SOURCE OPINION is weakest cited and fine.
The tokens-per-dollar range and tok/s/user range match C-4910e57ae3f8d9, but that span does not mention 'GLM-5.2' model scope; the model attribution is unsupported by the cited span.

Supports throughput/MFU, 93% pass rate, 27min compile time, and the 2-orders-of-magnitude reduction target. But 'broad library support now' relies on C-c43041301a37f3 (100k+ HF models collected), which is a list AWS collected, not demonstrated broad support — an overstatement.

The cited span says MoE combine/dispatch take 60-70% of communication volume but does not specify 'training/inference' scope; the card adds that scope unsupported. Also labelled MEASURED OBSERVATION with approximate=True, which matches.
